wins.label: Exceptional revenue growth acceleration
wins.evidence: Revenue grew 39% year-over-year, exceeding the high end of prior guidance by nearly 350 basis points

wins.label: U.S. commercial business milestone and momentum
wins.evidence: U.S. commercial revenue grew 71% year-over-year and surpassed $1 billion annual run rate for the first time, with $810 million in TCV bookings representing 183% year-over-year growth

wins.label: Strong profitability with expanding margins
wins.evidence: Adjusted operating margin of 44%, representing an 800 basis point increase compared to Q1 last year, with Rule of 40 score of 83

wins.label: AIP driving enterprise autonomy adoption
wins.evidence: Unrelenting demand for AIP continues to drive outperformance with customers like Walgreens automating 384 billion decisions daily and AIG expecting to double their 5-year CAGR

wins.label: Government business expansion and Maven adoption
wins.evidence: U.S. government revenue grew 45% year-over-year, Maven Smart System usage doubled in first 9 months of 2024 and doubled again in subsequent 5 months, with NATO adoption across 32 member states

risks.label: International commercial revenue decline
risks.evidence: First quarter international commercial revenue declined 5% year-over-year and 11% sequentially to $141 million, driven by continued headwinds in Europe

risks.label: European market weakness and structural challenges
risks.evidence: Europe is going through very structural change and doesn't quite get AI, with 90% of business outside Europe growing at 49% versus overall growth rates

risks.label: Increased expense growth expected
risks.evidence: We continue to expect to see a more significant increase in expense in 2025 as we invest in elite technical talent, product pipeline and AI production use cases

risks.label: Strategic commercial contracts revenue decline
risks.evidence: Q2 2025 revenue from strategic commercial contracts anticipated between $4-6 million compared to $9 million in Q2 2024

risks.label: Execution risk on ambitious scaling plans
risks.evidence: Company planning to scale significantly while maintaining profitability and Rule of 40 score of 80, requiring sustained execution across multiple fronts
